title: Native shared decision and saved review contexts
description: Use the isolated authenticated proof gateway and owned device. Select FARMSLOT_HOME, FARMSLOT_RUNS_DIR, FARMSLOT_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATION=1, FARMSLOT_OFFLINE_PROOF=1, FARMSLOT_NATIVE_RUN_RECEIPT and a per-device FARMSLOT_AGENT_DEVICE_STATE_DIR. A unique run is seeded only while the owned gateway is stopped; teardown removes that run. No publication or gate action is sent.

proofTargets.claim: The mounted run screen renders the saved review verdict and reviewed SHA from its shared full-run observation.
The embedded decision workspace derives its pending gate from the shared decision and full-run observations.
The actual gate action is enabled while both inputs are current, disabled while they are stale, and enabled after current reconnect reads without resolving the private decision.

The mounted diff derives its full run and recipe groups from shared observations; a cold offline restart restores the saved run and exact observation time, displays its age, and reconnects to current inputs.
The actual Sync artifacts button is enabled for current shared inputs and shows the real gateway refusal when its owned run has no slot.

The artifact view keeps its frozen decision query and shared manifest; cold offline startup restores the exact saved full run and observation time, renders its age with sync disabled, and waits for current run and recipe reads on reconnect.

prepare.intent: Seed one uniquely owned pending gate and saved review before gateway restart.

open-review.intent: Open the actual run evidence screen and require its current full-run observation.

review-visible.intent: The native saved-review panel renders its canonical full verdict.

sha-visible.intent: The native saved-review panel preserves the reviewed commit identity.

review-capture.intent: Record the actual saved review panel.

open-workspace.intent: Open the embedded decision workspace with the real pending gate.

workspace-visible.intent: The actual decision workspace is mounted.

workspace-capture.intent: Record the current shared gate workspace.

stale-gate.intent: Verify the actual gate button changes from enabled to disabled across disconnect and back after current reconnect reads.

stale-proof.intent: Require actual native button readiness and unchanged pending decision bytes.

cleanup.intent: Remove only the unique private fixture with the owned gateway stopped.

review-data-proof.intent: Require the real mounted context to observe current shared data before the visible UI checks.

workspace-data-proof.intent: Require the real mounted context to observe current shared data before the visible UI checks.

capture-start.intent: Start native recording before setup and endpoint proof.

open-diff.intent: Open the actual diff and require its rendered inputs to equal canonical observations.

diff-visible.intent: Require the real native diff screen to be visible.

diff-capture.intent: Show the selected run and recipe context before disconnect so its saved offline counterpart can be compared.

cold-diff.intent: Cold restart offline and prove exact saved run, visible age, no invented recipe data and current reconnect.

diff-proof.intent: Require the actual cold diff and reconnect proof.

open-artifacts.intent: Open the selected decision inventory and exercise its real sync command without a worker slot.

artifacts-data-proof.intent: Require canonical rendered inputs, frozen query selection and the visible gateway refusal.

artifacts-visible.intent: The selected run title is visible above its Files inventory.

artifacts-capture.intent: Show the current decision inventory and its artifact sync result before disconnect.

cold-artifacts.intent: Restart offline and require the saved manifest, exact observation time, visible age, disabled sync and current reconnect.

artifacts-proof.intent: Require the real artifact view to restore saved context and reauthorize actions after reconnect.

artifact-item-visible.intent: The saved artifact inventory row appears in the actual Files list.
